## Appearance

## Personality

Flossie Tulk is an unpleasant, caustic-tongued, and malicious young woman who lacks a creative mind and struggles with arithmetic. Despite these traits, she is known for her boldness when asking questions in class. Outside of her academic pursuits—which she undertakes simply to gain an education—she possesses skills in knitting lace and stepping along wooden fences, and once desired to play the fairy queen in a school dialogue.

## History

Flossie Tulk earned recognition by winning the top prize for knitted lace at the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). During a party hosted by [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), Flossie dared [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to walk across the ridgepole of the kitchen roof, an act that resulted in [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) slipping and breaking her ankle. Later, Flossie attended Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), where she took classes alongside peers such as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## Relationships

### [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flossie-tulk--hugh-carrow.md)

Flossie and Hugh are traveling companions who share rides in his carriage. While Hugh attends school alongside Flossie's peers, their direct interactions primarily center on their shared transit.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034)_

- Comrade of — traveling companion in his carriage  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flossie-tulk--nell-harcourt.md)

Flossie shares a peer rivalry with [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that manifests in physical dares and fence-walking games. Their competition turned serious at a party hosted by [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), where Flossie dared [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to walk across the kitchen roof's ridgepole. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepted the challenge but slipped and fell, breaking her ankle in the process.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII.
